title: Processing speed
description: How fast the worker's speed-tracked steps run: the on-demand cut-out and the head track, per version: seconds of work per second of video. Lower is better. Each version's first run is marked on the chart. See app_docs/measurement.md, Cut-out speed and Head-track speed.

list.name: Mask tool version first seen
list.textFormat: Mask tool version {{mask_tool_version}} reported its first cut-out here.

list.name: Head track version first seen
list.textFormat: Head track version {{head_track_version}} reported its first run here.

panels.title: Cut-out speed
panels.description: Seconds of work per second of video cut out, by mask tool version (the legend's tool v3, v2, ...). Work is the wall time of the cut-out step that made masks; video is the length of the footage those masks cover. Lower is better: the same footage takes less time. Each point is the ratio over the last rate interval; a gap means no cut-out made masks in that window. The vertical marker at the bottom of the chart shows when a version first reported.

defaults.unit: suffix: seconds of work per second of video

panels.title: Head-track speed
panels.description: Seconds of work per second of video head-tracked, by head track version (the legend's head track v3, v2, ...). Work is the wall time of the head_track step; video is the footage its samples stand for (one per 0.25 s). Lower is better: the same footage takes less time. Each point is the ratio over the last rate interval; a gap means no head track ran in that window. The vertical marker at the bottom of the chart shows when a version first reported.

defaults.unit: suffix: seconds of work per second of video
